title: The copy uploaded to Google Play still carries the 'download the new version file from GitHub' update path
what: Google Play gets the same build as the GitHub file, and that build is marked 'GitHub copy' by default. On Play copies the app normally asks the phone who installed it and uses Play's own update. When the phone cannot say, it falls back to the GitHub default and shows 'Tap Update now to download the file, then open it to install', sending the member to download an app file outside Play. Play's rules say an app from Play may not update itself by any way other than Play.
expected: The build sent to Google Play is marked as a Play copy, so it can never offer an app file from outside Play.
how_often: only when the phone cannot say who installed the app
fix_line: Build the Play copy with the Play mark set, so the outside-Play update can never show

title: On an iPhone the update screen would tell members to download an Android app file
what: The update check decides between Google Play and GitHub only. An iPhone cannot say who installed the app, so it falls to the GitHub default and would show 'A new MettleUp is here' with 'download the file, then open it to install', pointing at the Android file. Apple rejects apps that point to other ways of installing or updating, and the member cannot use the file anyway.
expected: On an iPhone the update screen sends members to the App Store, or does not show.
how_often: every update, once the iPhone app ships
fix_line: Add an App Store path to the update check before the iPhone app ships

title: The AI coach's replies have no way to report a bad or offensive answer
what: Coach chat shows the AI's replies as bubbles and cards, but a reply cannot be pressed, flagged or reported. Google Play asks apps that show AI-made content to let users report offensive answers inside the app. The chat is hidden today, so this bites the day it is switched on.
expected: Each coach reply has a way to report it, and the reports reach MettleUp.
how_often: every coach reply, once the chat is shown
fix_line: Add a report choice on each coach reply before the chat is switched on
